battle.name: 永樂城之戰
battle.theater: 寧夏鹽池、羅山道與韋州
battle.brief: 元豐五年，宋神宗不聽撤兵之議，命將領徐禧自綏德、靈州一線出師，循羅山道西進，二月攻破西夏的永樂城，奪城、收降卒、繳馬械，進取韋州堡寨；詔書促令班師，所取城邑多數歸還西夏。卡面的希臘火不在這個內陸高原戰場，同期可對照的，是宋軍的火箭、猛火油柜與霹靂砲。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 永樂城之戰是元豐五年（一〇八二）宋夏戰爭在羅山道上的第二度交鋒，屬北宋主動出擊西夏的一場邊戰。宋方的體系以皇帝趙頊與樞密院調度為中樞，陝西分鄜延、涇原、環慶、熙河四路經略使分統兵將，京師禁軍精銳與西北邊軍為骨干，募兵、廂軍、蕃兵、弩手，以及以弓弩手和匠戶編成的攻城部隊相配合，並在前線築堡屯田，把出兵的基地由州城推到邊牆與羅山一線的堡寨。西夏一方由主諒祚與其母后沒臷氏（梁太后）共治，樞密院掌兵，境內以御營精騎與漢兵、橫山羌兵組成的邊軍為主，槍手、弩手、弓手分編各部，另有披重甲擔任突陣的鐵鷂子，用以在堅城之下撕開缺口。永樂城正是西夏經營羅山道的堡寨節點，北控鹽池荒原、南接韋州高平，既是屯糧之所，也是西夏攔截宋軍沿羅山道西進的關節。兩軍的補給都靠陸路車隊：宋自京師與秦鳳運軍糧至環慶、涇原的倉場，再轉涇原道北送；西夏則倚河套、橫山與興慶府的草場。開春時節黃河封凍未解，正是雙方都以騎兵和輕裝部隊爭奪邊寨的季節。
countriesEn: The Battle of Yongle City in 1082 was the second stage of the Song–Western Xia struggle on the Luoshan road, fought during the Yuanfeng era of the Northern Song as an offensive operation against the Tangut state. On the Song side the system was directed from the centre by the emperor Zhao Xu through the Privy Council; Shaanxi was divided into four routes — Fuyan, Jingyuan, Huanqing and Xihe — each under a regional commissioner who commanded its own troops and officers. The backbone consisted of the imperial guards and the frontier armies of the northwest, supplemented by recruited soldiers, militia, Tangut and Tibetan auxiliaries, crossbowmen, and assault units drawn from crossbowmen and artisan households. The Song practice was to push the basing areas of an expedition forward, from the prefectural towns out to the frontier wall and to a chain of forts along the Luoshan road. On the Western Xia side the state was governed by the young emperor Liangzuo together with his mother, the empress dowager Mozan (the widow of the Liang clan), with the Privy Council holding the military command. The field army was built around the imperial camp cavalry and the frontier garrisons of Han and Hengshan Qiang troops, with lancers, crossbowmen and archers organised in separate units, and with an armoured shock corps, the Tieyaozi, used to tear gaps in a stubborn defence. Yongle City was the node of a system of Tangut forts along the Luoshan road: it commanded the salt flats to the north and Wuzhou and Gaoping to the south, serving both as a granary and as the hinge at which the Xia intercepted Song columns marching west. Supply for both sides ran by road. The Song moved grain from the capital and from Qinlong to the depots at Huanqing and Jingyuan, and then pushed it north along the Jingyuan route; the Xia drew on the pastures of Hetao, Hengshan and the Xingqing plain. Early spring, with the Yellow River still frozen over, was precisely the season in which both sides contested the frontier forts with cavalry and light-footed columns.
people: 宋方關鍵人物是皇帝趙頊與樞密院。趙頊自熙寧以來銳意拓邊，元豐四年命蔡挺、王韶分道出師，五路伐夏一度攻入靈州；靈州既下，夏主求和，朝議主撤，蔡挺、王韶力主乘勝，而前線將領徐禧更不願得而復失。元豐五年正月，宋廷終於命徐禧將兵自綏德、靈州一線出師，循羅山道西進。徐禧是這一戰的實際統帥，他率所部攻破永樂城、追奔韋州，奪取城中的器械、馬匹，收其降卒；詔書到營、促令班師，他進退失據，未幾病歿於軍中，前線為之震動。與他同行的涇原蕃部將領、鄜延與環慶的邊軍指揮各負其責：部分人主張乘勝深入，部分人擔心糧道與孤軍深入。西夏一方，諒祚尚在少年，兵權與政令多出於母后沒臷氏之手，前線由樞密院調度，羅山各堡寨的守將多為漢人將校，另有羌人與蕃兵助守；夏使入宋求和的時間點，恰在宋廷改為進攻之際。
peopleEn: The decisive figure on the Song side was the emperor Zhao Xu and the Privy Council. From the Xining reign onward Zhao had pressed the policy of frontier expansion, and in the fourth year of Yuanfeng he sent Cai Ting and Wang Shao out by several routes, the five-pronged offensive of 1081 driving as far as Lingzhou. With Lingzhou taken, the Xia ruler sued for peace and voices for withdrawal rose in the court. Cai Ting and Wang Shao argued for pressing the advantage, and the commanders in the field, above all Xu Xi, were unwilling to win a city only to lose it again. In the first month of the fifth year of Yuanfeng the court finally authorised Xu Xi to take troops out from the Suide–Lingzhou line and march west along the Luoshan road. Xu Xi was the operational commander of the engagement: he stormed Yongle City, pursued the enemy towards Wuzhou, seized the stores, weapons and horses found in the place, and took the surrendered men. When the rescript arrived ordering the army back, he was caught between advance and retreat, and before long he died of illness in camp, which shaken the whole frontier command. The Jingyuan tribal contingents who marched with him, and the commanders of the Fuyan and Huanqing frontier armies, each carried their own responsibilities: some pressed for deeper penetration, others worried about the supply line and a column marching alone into hostile country. On the Xia side Liangzuo was still a boy, and military and political authority lay largely with his mother, the empress dowager Mozan; the Privy Council in the capital directed the front, the garrisons of the Luoshan forts were mostly held by Han officers, with Qiang and Tangut auxiliaries in support. The Xia envoy who sued for peace reached the Song court at precisely the moment the Song had changed to a policy of attack.
kits: 卡面這件兵器是希臘火——拜占庭帝國自七世紀起使用的配方不明的燃燒劑，配在銅管與虹吸管中施放，用於海戰焚燒敵艦，也用於圍城時燒毀城牆與攻城器械；配方是帝國的機密，最終隨船一同沉沒。它在帝國軍務中的位置相當明確：銅管噴射器是攻城與守城的固定火器，專司攻擊木構、帆布與糧草堆，不是野戰中步騎對壘的裝備。永樂城建在羅山深處的高原上，四周是夯土城垣、黃土塬地與淖澤，無海港、無艦隊，與希臘火的使用前提完全不相干；本戰役雙方都沒有這種裝備。宋軍的燃燒手段是火箭與《武經總要》所載的猛火油柜，夏軍則倚堡寨現成的柴草與油脂就地縱火。可與之對照的，是同年宋軍攻靈州時記載曾用過的霹靂砲等火器，以及宋軍攻城所用的雲梯、穴地、撞竿、飛石、蒙皮大盾與弩手營；西夏守軍則以木拒馬、鹿角、壘石、弓弩構成城防，鐵鷂子披重甲擔任突陣。西夏騎兵乘唐馬與西夏馬，人人有甲，攜長刀、狼牙棒與標槍。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is Greek fire — a burning mixture of unknown formulation used by the Byzantine Empire from the seventh century, discharged from bronze tubes and siphons, used in naval battle to burn enemy shipping and in sieges to set fire to walls and siege engines. Its place in the imperial order of battle was clear: the bronze-tube projector was a fixed fire weapon belonging to siege and defence, intended for targets of timber, canvas and stacked fodder rather than anything that stood in the line of a cavalry melee. Yongle City stood on a plateau in the depths of the Luoshan highlands, ringed by rammed-earth ramparts, loess tablelands and marshy hollows, with no harbour and no fleet; the preconditions for Greek fire were simply absent, and neither side in this battle possessed such a device. The Song equivalents were fire arrows and the oil cabinet for fierce burning recorded in the Wujing Zongyao, while the Xia relied on the timber, brushwood and oil at hand in their forts to set fires on the terrain. The closest counterparts on the Song side in the same year were the thunder-thunder bomb and other fire weapons recorded as used against Lingzhou, together with the ladders, saps, battering rams, stone-throwers, hide-covered shields and crossbow units of a Song siege; the Xia defences were built from wooden horse, caltrops, stacked stone and crossbows, with the armoured Tieyaozi charged with the assault. The Xia cavalry rode Tang and Xia horses, every rider carried some armour together with long sabre, club and javelin.
tactics: 宋軍的戰法是循險而進、據壘而攻。元豐四年五路大軍已拿下西夏的黃河東岸門戶靈州，但兵力分散在千里戰線上，糧秣自京師運到前線需時月，無法合兵深入。徐禧的偏師是唯一被授權向羅山道推進的一支，行動原則是不與夏人主力糾纏：沿途不攻大城，只取羅山道沿線的堡寨、驛亭與烽燧，步步為營，把後方基地從綏德與靈州向前推到羅山、韋州一線；遇夏軍遊騎便以步兵結長蛇陣拒之，騎兵在兩翼張開，掩護步軍列陣進攻。待永樂城守軍出城反撲或援兵抵達之前，隨即完成對城的包圍：以雲梯靠牆，以穴地挖通至城基，同時在城北高地上築壘築臺，居高臨下射擊城頭守軍，切斷其水源與樵採，封鎖城下的退路。破城之後立即分兵搜捕殘部、收繳馬匹器械、整飭降卒，然後不等詔令，循城下驛道向韋州推進。西夏的戰法是以堡串珠、遊騎遲滯：羅山沿線每隔數十里設一堡，堡與堡之間以信旗和驛騎相連，宋軍攻下一堡，夏軍即退守下一堡，不與宋軍決戰；同時以精騎游弋於宋軍糧隊兩側，切斷涇原、環慶之間的運道，迫其分兵護糧。夏軍還在春末化凍後利用黃河與荒原的騎兵迂迴，宋軍深遠唯一、糧道單薄，攻勢因此在韋州城下自行耗盡。
tacticsEn: The Song method was to advance by secure routes and to attack from prepared positions. The five armies had already taken the Yellow River's eastern gateway, Lingzhou, in the fourth year of Yuanfeng, but the force was spread along a front of a thousand li, the grain took months to travel from the capital to the line, and no single mass could be concentrated for a deep advance. Xu Xi's detached column was the only one authorised to push along the Luoshan road, and its principle was to avoid entanglement with the main Xia army: it did not strike at the great cities on the way, but took the forts, posting stations and beacon towers of the road one by one, making the rear bases of Suide and Lingzhou advance to the Luoshan and Wuzhou lines. When Xia cavalry appeared, the infantry closed into a long serpentine line to hold, while cavalry opened on both flanks to cover the advance of the foot. Before the garrison of Yongle City could sortie in force or the relief columns could arrive, the investment of the city was complete: scaling ladders against the wall, saps dug through to the foundations, and at the same time works and firing platforms raised on the high ground north of the city, so that the defenders on the wall were shot into from above while their water supply and firewood were cut off and the road out sealed. After the city fell, the troops were divided at once to hunt down the remnants, to collect horses and weapons and to sort out the surrendered men; then, without waiting for any rescript, they pushed on towards Wuzhou along the post road below the city. The Xia method was to string forts like beads and to slow the enemy with flying cavalry: a fort every several dozen li along the road, linked by signal flags and relay riders, so that when the Song took one fort the Xia fell back to the next, refusing a set-piece battle. At the same time their picked horse ranged along both sides of the Song baggage road, cutting the supply line between Jingyuan and Huanqing and forcing the Song to detach troops to guard it. After the thaw the Xia also used cavalry to turn the Song flanks across the Yellow River and the salt flats, and the Song advance, solitary and long-strung on supplies, spent itself at the foot of Wuzhou.
data: 關於兵力的記載分歧很大，須分辨誇大。元豐四年五路伐夏，各路報數從數十萬不等，實際投入的兵員當在十萬量級，其中鄜延、涇原兩路是攻靈州的主力；一〇八二年正月出師攻永樂城的徐禧部，兵數常被記為步騎萬餘，但同一系統的記載亦作數千之眾，可信的是這是一支輕裝深入的偏師，兵力當在數千至萬餘之間。夏軍方面，永樂城守軍為城內數百至千餘的守卒加民兵，羅山各堡寨與興慶府方向的援軍合則上萬，單獨出擊的遊騎則是成建制的百人隊。距離上，羅山道自綏德、靈州向西直抵永樂城，路程約三四百里，途中多塬地、瀚海與淖澤，馬隊可行而車隊難行，糧秣靠人背馱。時間上，宋軍正月出師、二月抵城、二月破城、三月進至韋州，詔令退兵時已近暮春，正是夏軍騎兵戰力上升而宋軍糧秣見底之際。戰果方面，永樂城與韋州一帶堡寨的器械、馬匹多被宋軍收繳，降卒與俘虜以千計；一〇八三年西夏遣使謝罪，雙方依舊界罷兵，所取堡寨多數歸還西夏。
dataEn: The figures for the armies are given inconsistently and have to be discounted. For the five-pronged offensive of 1081 the routes reported numbers running into the hundreds of thousands, while the troops actually committed were on the order of a hundred thousand, with Fuyan and Jingyuan carrying the main weight against Lingzhou. For the column that marched against Yongle City in the first month of 1082 the figures commonly given are some ten thousand of foot and horse, though the same annals also put it at a few thousand; what can be said with confidence is that this was a light column advancing deep, numbered in the thousands rather than the tens of thousands. On the Xia side the garrison of Yongle City comprised several hundred to a little over a thousand men and militia, and the reinforcements drawn from the other Luoshan forts and from the direction of Xingqing numbered over ten thousand when combined, while the flying cavalry that fought in single file came in formed bands of a hundred riders. In distance, the Luoshan road ran some three or four hundred li west from Suide and Lingzhou to Yongle City, the way lying across tablelands, salt desert and marshy hollows where horse columns could pass but wagons could not, so the grain went forward on men's backs and on pack animals. In time, the Song marched out in the first month, reached the city in the second, stormed it in the second and reached Wuzhou in the third; the rescript for withdrawal arrived as late spring was near, when the Xia cavalry was at its strongest and the Song grain was running out. As to results, the weapons, horses and stores of Yongle City and the Wuzhou forts fell to the Song, and the surrendered and captive men were counted in thousands; in 1083 the Xia sent an embassy to apologise, both sides stood down on the old frontier, and most of the forts taken were handed back to the Xia.
cause: 永樂城之戰的直接起因，是宋夏對羅山道的爭奪。元豐四年五路大軍攻入靈州，把西夏的門戶推到黃河西岸，夏主諒祚與其母后沒臷氏為免局勢崩潰，遣使議和；宋廷內部，主撤與主戰的聲音相持不下，樞密院與前線將領都看出靈州若無兵坐守、必為夏人重取，於是朝議改為乘勝進取，但只准有限度的深入。永樂城恰在西夏防線的關節上：它扼住羅山道西口，控制由靈州、綏德通向韋州與興慶府的山路，是夏人經營數十年的邊防節點，志在必守；宋廷則希望借靈州既得的聲勢，把羅山道上的堡寨連成線，切斷西夏南北調兵與馬匹供應的通道。另一層原因是宋夏對邊界土地與水草的爭奪：羅山南北都是牧地與屯田之地，夏人倚堡寨控制水源和草場，宋人則視羅山為可築寨、可屯田、可置縣的邊地。元豐五年正月，夏使仍在議和途中，宋神宗已下詔令前線進攻，這場戰役就是在和議與進攻同時進行的情況下打了起來。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the Battle of Yongle City was the contest for the Luoshan road between Song and Xia. When the five armies of 1081 had entered Lingzhou and pushed the Tangut gateway back to the west bank of the Yellow River, Liangzuo and his mother, the empress dowager Mozan, sent an embassy to sue for peace, so as not to see the whole position collapse. Inside the Song court the voices for withdrawal and for continuing the war were evenly matched; the Privy Council and the commanders in the field alike understood that Lingzhou, left without a garrison, would be retaken by the Xia, and the court therefore changed to a policy of pressing the advantage, but only to a limited extent. Yongle City lay at the hinge of the Tangut defence: it held the western mouth of the Luoshan road and the mountain track leading from Lingzhou and Suide towards Wuzhou and Xingqing, a frontier node the Xia had built up over decades and one they were determined to keep. The Song, for their part, hoped to use the momentum of Lingzhou to link the forts of the Luoshan road into a single line and cut the Xia movement of troops north and south and the supply of horses. A further reason lay in the dispute over land and water on the frontier: the ground north and south of Luoshan was pasture and farmland, the Xia relied on their forts to hold the water and the grass, while the Song regarded Luoshan as frontier land on which forts could be built, land reclaimed and a county established. In the first month of the fifth year of Yuanfeng the Xia envoy was still on his way, and the rescript of the Song emperor had already ordered the advance; this campaign was therefore fought while the peace talks and the attack were running at the same time.
impact: 永樂城之戰是宋夏戰爭中的一場戰術勝利，也是一場戰略上的僵局。宋軍在兩個多月裡深入羅山道三百餘里，連拔堡寨、破城池，證明了宋軍的攻城能力與邊軍的野戰水準；但補給線被拉得過長，兵分五路而集中不起來，前線一旦離開堡寨群就失去保護，攻下來的城要守、要屯、要運糧，一處失守便全線崩潰。永樂城得而復失的結局，讓宋廷更清楚認識到取城不等於得地。此役之後，宋夏在羅山一線的堡寨體系更趨密集：宋方加築環慶、鄜延沿線新寨，推行屯田與營田；夏方則把羅山堡寨的守備編制固定化，設兵馬司、加強巡邏。一〇八三年西夏遣使謝罪、雙方依舊界罷兵，邊境獲得數年相對安寧，直到元祐、紹聖年間雙方再度在羅山、橫山用兵。更深一層的影響在戰役方法上：與此前靈州之戰一樣，宋夏戰爭的勝負關鍵被證明在後勤與堡寨體系，而不在任何一件火器或攻城器的性能。
impactEn: The Battle of Yongle City was a tactical victory for the Song and a strategic stalemate. In a little over two months the Song army pushed three hundred li or more into the Luoshan road, taking forts and storming a city, and demonstrated both its siegecraft and the fighting quality of the frontier troops. But the supply line was stretched too thin, the force was divided among five routes and could not be concentrated, and once the leading troops left the chain of forts they lost their protection. A city taken has to be garrisoned, farmed and supplied, and the loss of one place would have brought the whole line down. The fact that Yongle City was lost again after being taken taught the court that taking a city is not the same as gaining territory. After this engagement the system of forts along the Luoshan road grew denser on both sides: the Song built new forts along the Huanqing and Fuyan lines and pushed forward settlement and tuntian, while the Xia fixed the garrison organisation of the Luoshan forts, set up offices for troops and horses and increased the patrol. When the Xia sent an embassy to apologise in 1083 and both sides stood down on the old frontier, the border enjoyed several years of comparative quiet, until Song and Xia again took up arms in Luoshan and Hengshan during the Yuanyou and Shaosheng reigns. The deeper lesson concerned method: as at Lingzhou, the outcome of the Song–Xia war was decided by logistics and by the fort system, not by the performance of any single fire weapon or siege engine.
result: 結果是：宋軍依詔攻破了永樂城，奪取其城、其器械、其降卒，並乘勢取韋州一帶的堡寨，一度把西夏的羅山防線推到靈州以西；但同一道詔書也終止了這次進攻。前線主將徐禧在軍中病歿，宋軍依令退兵，所取城邑多數交還西夏，邊界大致回到戰前態勢。西夏方面，母后沒臷氏主持的求和派在一〇八三年正式遣使謝罪，雙方重議疆界，羅山道沿線的堡寨仍歸西夏控制，宋軍則退守環慶、鄜延一線。戰役的勝負因此要分兩層看：就一場城池攻奪而言，宋軍得手；就一場旨在開疆拓土的戰爭而言，雙方各無所得，一場無法持續的攻勢被糧道與詔令截斷。西夏從此把羅山堡寨視為不可分割的核心防區，而宋朝在西北的戰略，也由取城逐步轉向築寨、屯田、斷其交通。
resultEn: The result was this: the Song army broke Yongle City on the strength of the rescript, took the city, its stores and its surrendered men, and rode on to the forts around Wuzhou, pushing the Xia defence on the Luoshan road back beyond Lingzhou for a time; the same rescript, however, brought the advance to an end. The commander Xu Xi died of illness in camp, the army withdrew in obedience to the order, and most of the towns that had been taken were handed back to the Xia, leaving the frontier roughly where it had been. On the Xia side the peace party led by the empress dowager Mozan sent a formal embassy of apology in 1083, the two sides renegotiated the boundary, the forts along the Luoshan road remained in Xia hands, and the Song pulled back behind the Huanqing and Fuyan lines. The outcome therefore has to be read on two levels. As a contest for a walled city, the Song had its way; as a war of territorial expansion, neither side gained anything, and an offensive that could not be sustained was cut short by the supply line and by the rescript. From then on the Xia treated the Luoshan forts as an indivisible core of its defence, and Song strategy in the northwest gradually shifted from taking cities towards building forts, reclaiming land and cutting the enemy's communications.
